question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a pink present, Bob has a yellow present, Claire has a grey present, Dave has a blue present, Eve has a black present, Fred has a gold present, and Gertrude has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Dave has the
Options:
(A) pink present
(B) yellow present
(C) grey present
(D) blue present
(E) black present
(F) gold present
(G) teal present
solution:
Present colors in each row are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: pink, yellow, grey, blue, black, gold, teal
1. Dave ↔ Bob: pink, blue, grey, yellow, black, gold, teal
2. Eve ↔ Fred: pink, blue, grey, yellow, gold, black, teal
3. Bob ↔ Claire: pink, grey, blue, yellow, gold, black, teal
4. Bob ↔ Alice: grey, pink, blue, yellow, gold, black, teal
5. Dave ↔ Gertrude: grey, pink, blue, teal, gold, black, yellow
6. Fred ↔ Dave: grey, pink, blue, black, gold, teal, yellow
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: grey, pink, blue, yellow, gold, teal, black
Dave has the yellow present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
